source_snapshot.procedure: Inspect BMC WebUI VLAN text, assign a VLAN to BMC, then assign the same VLAN to the client.
source_snapshot.criteria: Correct/readable display, connection loss after BMC-only tagging, and return after client tagging.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; unsafe literal uses `+5`, assumed channel/cipher and password argument.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with approved VLAN/channel/topology and recovery.

old_problem: The case remained on the Engineering Decision queue even though its action and Expected Result were already coherent; only the environment-specific tag, interface and recovery package were missing.
disposition_reason: The source intentionally creates a two-stage transaction: BMC-only tagging isolates the still-untagged peer, then matching peer tagging restores access. VLAN ID, interface/channel, direct-link or switch topology and timers are Project Configuration. They gate execution but do not require a new engineering decision. The DeepSeek literal is rejected rather than repaired by guessing.
decision_basis: XLSX row 827, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly read.
Procedure and Criteria agree on display, expected disconnect and recovery ordering; existing V3.1 analysis already marks source_conflict and blocked false.
IPMI defines VLAN ID as a LAN configuration parameter, but the actual supported channel/control path must be discovered for this BMC.
ED-20/ED-31 retain genuine WebUI presentation evidence and ED-36 converts missing tag/topology values from Pending to readiness prerequisites.

test_case.test_name: Verify BMC VLAN display and staged untagged-loss/tagged-recovery transaction
test_case.purpose: Verify the actual BMC WebUI presents VLAN controls correctly, an approved BMC VLAN write isolates the original untagged client as intended, configuring the peer path with the identical tag restores fresh authenticated access to the same BMC, and both ends can be restored safely.
required_package: Verified BMC serial/MAC, management interface/channel and supported WebUI/API/IPMI VLAN method
Approved isolated VLAN ID, baseline VLAN/native state, IP/subnet/gateway and direct-link or switch-port tag plan
Exact client NIC tagged-subinterface/namespace method and, if used, switch PVID/allowed-VLAN configuration
Independent local/OOB recovery, protected credentials, loss/recovery deadlines and rollback order
Project-supported browser/version matrix and readable-label expectations
test_case.test_command: Record the full BMC/client/switch baseline and verify WebUI VLAN text in each supported browser. After explicit approval, use the source-required WebUI or an approved equivalent to apply the approved numeric VLAN on the verified BMC interface. From an independent observer, prove fresh untagged transactions fail within deadline; do not mistake a stale session for access. Configure the exact client subinterface or switch path with the same tag, then prove recovery to the same BMC by MAC, certificate/serial and authenticated traffic. Read back VLAN state and restore BMC then peer in the pretested recovery-safe order.
test_case.expected_result: WebUI fields and saved VLAN value are readable/correct. BMC-only tagging causes the original untagged path to stop carrying fresh management traffic. Matching peer tagging restores the same BMC within the approved deadline with correct VLAN/IP/MAC and no leak to other VLANs. Rollback returns the original untagged/native state and stable access without duplicate address, loop or residual tag.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires browser visual evidence, exact approved tag/interface, independent timed loss, same-endpoint tagged recovery, protected readback and complete rollback. FAIL includes continued traffic over an unexplained path, no recovery, wrong BMC/tag/channel, VLAN leakage/loop, credential exposure or rollback failure. Missing tag/topology/recovery makes execution NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Use only an isolated approved VLAN and exact verified BMC; never copy `+5`, channel 1 or cipher 17 assumptions
Maintain independent recovery before the disruptive write
Protect credentials outside command arguments/logs and verify the platform-supported control
Prove loss with fresh traffic and recovery with immutable endpoint identity
Stop on persistent loss, wrong network, loop/leak or duplicate IP; no automatic retry or alternate-tag guessing
expected_evidence: BMC/interface/channel/MAC identity and full baseline/rollback values
Supported-browser WebUI screenshots before and after
Exact VLAN/topology approval and change audit
Client/switch tagged configuration and same-BMC recovery/readback
Restored state, isolation checks and BMC/network health logs
test_case.recovery: Use the independent local/OOB path to restore the saved BMC VLAN state, then restore the client/switch native state in the validated order. Verify MAC/certificate/serial and fresh management traffic on the original path. Preserve evidence and escalate rather than trying other VLANs automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The source describes a coherent staged isolation and recovery test.

blocked.reason: No core semantic blocker exists; execution is conditional on approved network inputs and recovery.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: VLAN ID, BMC interface/channel/control, client/switch topology, supported browsers, timers, credentials and rollback.
